one_line: A Tamil pepper trader of Muzuris navigating the Indo-Roman sea trade in the early centuries CE.

appearance.age_look: late 20s, lean but strong from port work and sea travel
appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, default expression calm and calculating with a hint of shonen-style determination
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled back into a small low knot at the back of the head, front kept tidy with a slight wave, simple narrow white cotton headband tied around the forehead
appearance.costume: era-accurate South Indian merchant attire: a finely woven off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to mid-calf with a neat front fold, bordered by a thin dark red stripe; upper body covered by a light beige short-sleeved cotton tunic reaching just below the hips, with side slits; over the left shoulder a soft handwoven shawl of muted indigo with subtle narrow ochre stripes, worn diagonally across the chest and hanging behind; simple brown leather sandals with thong straps; modest gold ear studs, a thin gold chain around the neck with a small circular pendant, and a set of three dark wooden bead bangles on the right wrist.
appearance.signature: A large woven coir and palm-leaf trade basket held in one hand, brimming with long black peppercorn spikes and a visible small leather pouch of gold coins tied to the basket’s rim.

ref_desc: A lean medium-brown Tamil pepper merchant with black hair in a low knot and white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti, beige tunic, indigo shawl with dark red border, simple gold and wooden ornaments, and carrying a pepper-filled trade basket with a leather coin pouch; colours off-white, indigo, dark red, brown, and gold.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of a Muzuris pepper merchant: a lean medium-brown South Indian man with an oval face, sharp dark eyes, and a neat short beard, black hair tied in a small low knot with a simple white headband. He wears an off-white cotton dhoti to mid-calf with a thin dark red border, a light beige short-sleeved tunic falling just below the hips, and a muted indigo shawl with subtle ochre stripes draped from the left shoulder across his chest and down his back. Add small gold ear studs, a thin gold necklace with a round pendant, and three dark wooden bead bangles on his right wrist, plus brown leather thong sandals. In his hand is a large woven coir and palm-leaf basket brimming with long black pepper spikes, with a small tied leather pouch of gold coins hanging from the basket’s rim. Use a palette dominated by off-white, indigo, dark red, brown, and gold, and present him facing forward in a neutral, clearly readable pose suitable for a character model sheet.
